title: Garry Potter
description: A multi-page encyclopedia of the Harry Potter universe that dynamically fetches character data from a remote REST API. It features filtering by house and role, and profiles with detailed information in a modal.

title: Weather App
description: A simple weather app that allows users to search for current weather conditions in a city. It pulls data from the OpenWeatherMap API and supports light and dark themes.

title: To-Do List App
description: A simple and intuitive to-do list app built with React. Manage your daily tasks, mark them as done, remove irrelevant ones or move them around in the list and stay organized!

title: Tomato
description: A simple and convenient food delivery app (frontend only) that allows you to browse the menu, filter dishes by category, has a functional shopping cart for adding a certain amount of products and ordering food from this app.

title: Loopstudios
description: A modern VR studio single-page website featuring a flexible responsive layout. Built using Grid layout. It includes fluid, dynamic animations on interactive cards.

title: Space Tourism
description: A multi-page space tourism website featuring interactive tabbed navigation built with a strict focus on web accessibility (a11y) and keyboard navigation. Includes a fully responsive layout and dynamic data loading from a local JSON file.
